what: Bail paths say skip to Step 18 while Step 17.5 is only inserted between Steps 17 and 18 and the plan refuses to retarget the ~24 bail bullets
scenario_or_breakage: Step 0/3/6/preflight stalls with STALL_TRACKING=true jump straight to Step 18 and never run classify/issue/recovery (only the subset that reaches Step 16→17→17.5 is covered)
suggested_fix: Add a single Step 18 entry guard: before any Step 18 work, if Step 17.5 has not run and STALL_TRACKING=true, execute Step 17.5; or retarget all skip-to-Step-18 directives to skip-to-Step-17.5
